subject: Request: Temporary SLO exception & evidence package for p50/p95 windowing
messages:
From: Kara Brennan <ops@fintrust.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Estes <tom.estes@fintrust.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API latency — p95 spikes last week

Naomi,

We dug through our telemetry and saw recurring p95 spikes across a handful of endpoints last Thursday (Jun 12) during a short maintenance window in our auth proxy. The impact pushed a few of our internal SLAs momentarily above the committed p95 target in the contract.

We appreciate that Redwood has a measurement window and carveout policy, but given our compliance timelines we need a temporary, documented exception while we complete a mitigations checklist and reconcile the legal language. Can your team supply: 1) a short evidence bundle showing the event(s) and tail-profile (CSV or chart), 2) your proposed wording for a one-month carveout covering those timestamps, and 3) a DocuSign-friendly amendment we can circulate to Procurement?

Attaching our initial dive notes (referenced in the CSV). Happy to jump on a quick call today if helpful.

Thanks,
Kara Brennan
Director, Cloud Ops — FinTrust Bank
ops@fintrust.com

Attachment(s): fintrust_dive_notes.txt

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Kara Brennan <ops@fintrust.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API latency — p95 spikes last week

Kara — thanks for the clear summary and the CSV. I’m looping in Ben (SRE, infra) and Vivek (Head of Hosting) to validate the telemetry and draft the exception language.

Planned next steps: 
- Ben: run a tail-profile analysis and produce a compact evidence CSV + timeline.
- Naomi (me): draft the temporary carveout wording and a short amendment that Procurement can sign (DocuSign-ready).
- Vivek: review for operational approval and sign-off on any SLA deviations.

Could you confirm the exact timestamps you want carved out (your notes point to 2025-06-12 01:10–01:45 UTC and a secondary bump at 02:05–02:12 UTC)? Also confirm whether this carveout should be limited to the affected API routes (auth/token, auth/validate) or the whole account.

I’ll aim to get the evidence bundle and draft amendment over to you by end of day tomorrow (Jun 19).

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Principal Account Lead, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Attachment(s): none

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, Kara Brennan <ops@fintrust.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T13:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API latency — p95 spikes last week

Naomi / Kara — I ran a focused tail analysis against our hosted API measurement logs and the outputs are attached. Summary: 
- Primary cluster experienced a short-lived KV cache miss storm triggered by an upstream auth proxy retry loop. That produced a ~35s tail for a small percentage of auth/token requests at p99; p95 moved from our normal ~180ms to ~720ms in the affected 35-minute window.
- The anomaly correlates with your timestamps: main impact 2025-06-12T01:11:00Z — 2025-06-12T01:46:00Z; smaller second bump at 2025-06-12T02:04:00Z — 2025-06-12T02:13:00Z.
- Affected routes: /auth/token and /auth/validate (exact match). Customer production traffic on other route groups did not show statistically significant p95 shifts.

I’ve attached: fintrust_slo_tail_analysis.csv (per-route p50/p95/p99 by minute), and a 1-page summary (request_summary.pdf). The evidence supports a narrowly scoped carveout.

Operational suggestion: we can propose a one-month targeted carveout that excludes the two windows above and restricts scope to the two auth routes. That keeps broad SLAs intact.

—Ben Carter
SRE, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): fintrust_slo_tail_analysis.csv, request_summary.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Kara Brennan <ops@fintrust.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API latency — p95 spikes last week

Thanks Ben — good, concrete analysis. Naomi / Kara: from an operational and legal posture I approve drafting a temporary, route-scoped carveout as follows (draft language below). Legal will want to review before any DocuSign circulation, but I’m comfortable with this as an interim measure while FinTrust completes its own mitigation validation.

Draft carveout wording (operationally scoped):
"For the period from 2025-06-12T01:10:00Z through 2025-07-12T01:10:00Z, Redwood and FinTrust agree to exclude from p95 uptime calculations any requests to the following routes: /auth/token and /auth/validate, for the specific timestamp windows 2025-06-12T01:11:00Z—2025-06-12T01:46:00Z and 2025-06-12T02:04:00Z—2025-06-12T02:13:00Z as evidenced in the attached telemetry. All other routes and time windows remain subject to the standard p50/p95 SLOs defined in the agreement"

Two asks before I give formal sign-off: 1) Kara — confirm FinTrust accepts the one-month effective period and the route/time bounding; 2) Marissa — can Legal/Contracting review and produce a DocuSign-ready amendment tomorrow?

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Hosting & Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Kara Brennan <ops@fintrust.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, Tom Estes <tom.estes@fintrust.com>
Date: 2025-06-19T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Submission of evidence pack + DocuSign amendment link

Kara / Tom — attaching the evidence bundle Ben produced and the proposed amendment language (below). Marissa, thank you for fast-turn review and the DocuSign wrapper.

Summary of submission: 
- Evidence: fintrust_slo_tail_analysis.csv (per-minute quantiles), request_summary.pdf (one-page human readable summary), and a short forensic note from FinTrust ops (we received your dive notes).
- Proposed carveout wording (same as Vivek’s approved language).
- DocuSign link: see attached docusign-slo-amendment-link.txt (short URL).

Please reply with a signed DocuSign or questions. We’ll mark the carveout as in-effect once the document is executed and will record the exception in our SLO ledger and customer portal. After the one-month period, we’ll run a joint review to confirm no regression or to discuss further remediation or billing adjustments.

Thanks again — I’ll stand by for the signature and will schedule a 30-minute sync for Monday to walk through the CSV if helpful.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Principal Account Lead, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Attachment(s): fintrust_slo_tail_analysis.csv, request_summary.pdf, docusign-slo-amendment-link.txt
